verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred top-to-bottom order and hierarchy, but the glow circle has slid right so it no longer sits behind the can, the NEW and LIMITED RUN badges are spread too far apart, and the logo, badge and 'Swipe up' text is tiny. B has a strong headline, but it moves the minor 'Swipe up to shop' line up to a large spot above the product where it competes with the message. The badges are dumped left-aligned under the CTA, off the centre axis, in reversed order and apart from the product. The glow circle is also off-centre from the can, and there is a dead gap between the can and the CTA.
